ownerDecisions: io.netty.handler.codec maps to namespace Netty.NET.Handler.Codec (owner choice 2026-11-18: follow the Java package path, so handler and codec-http continue as Netty.NET.Handler.* and Netty.NET.Handler.Codec.Http).

The project, folder and assembly are Netty.NET.Handler.Codec, the namespace root of the module (owner decision 2026-11-19; it replaces the first name Netty.NET.Codec.Base, taken from the Maven artifact netty-codec-base, whose JPMS module name is io.netty.codec). Every other Netty.NET project uses its namespace root as its project name, and the .NET guideline Names of Assemblies and DLLs suggests to "name the DLL based on the common prefix of the namespaces contained in the assembly". The common prefix alone would give codec-http (packages http, rtsp and spdy) the same name, so each later module takes the namespace of its main package: codec-http is Netty.NET.Handler.Codec.Http and handler is Netty.NET.Handler. The tests use Netty.NET.Handler.Codec.Tests like the other test projects.

bytes, json and string keep their package names: Netty.NET.Handler.Codec.Bytes, .Json and .String. Code under these namespaces uses the string keyword, never String member access.
